methods.description: Checks a raid table against the bots on disk and writes it to the mod's raids/raids.json. Returns ok, file and diagnostics.

methods.name: editor.recipes.delete
methods.description: Deletes a recipe file of a mod.

params.description: Params of methods that take a file of a mod.

methods.name: editor.recipes.list
methods.description: Every recipe file of a mod, with its recipe.

params.description: Params of methods that take a mod.

methods.name: editor.recipes.save
methods.description: Checks and writes a recipe as the Part Editor's Recipes tab does (previous_file is removed when the id changed). Returns ok, id, file and diagnostics.

previous_file.description: The file it was listed from, removed when its id changed.

methods.name: editor.sounds.get
methods.description: The events of a sound bank (the mod's default bank when path is null); empty when it is new.

path.description: Sound bank file under sounds/; null is the mod's default bank.

methods.name: editor.sounds.list
methods.description: A mod's sound event files.

params.description: Params of methods that take a mod.

methods.name: editor.sounds.save
methods.description: Replaces a sound bank's events, checks them as loading would and writes the file. Returns ok, id, file and diagnostics.

events.description: Every event of the bank, replacing them.

path.description: Sound bank file under sounds/; null is the mod's default bank.

methods.name: editor.templates
methods.description: Template names for editor.part.new and editor.bot.new.

methods.name: lua.check
methods.description: Compiles a script (source text, or mod and path of a file) the way the host does, without running it. Returns ok, or the line, column and message of the first error.

mod.description: Or: the mod of a script file.

path.description: And the file's path inside it.

methods.name: lua.eval
methods.description: Runs Lua once in a throwaway sandbox with what part scripts start with (safe core libraries and vec3, no io, files or world) under the host's instruction budget. A single expression returns its value. Returns ok, values, printed output and error.

source.description: Lua to run; a single expression returns its value.

methods.name: lua.messages
methods.description: The newest lines of the part and bot script consoles, oldest first: source (parts or bots), kind (print, warning, error), script, creation, part, text, tick. Subscribe to the messages topic to have them pushed instead.

since_tick.description: Only lines written after this tick.

kinds.description: Only these kinds: print, warning, error.

limit.description: Newest lines to return, 1 to 500; default 100.

methods.name: mechanica.auth
methods.description: Gives the endpoint's token. Needed first when the host set one; grants that token's scopes.

methods.name: mechanica.describe
methods.description: Every method (Action API actions and queries, built-ins and module methods) with its scope, description and a JSON Schema of its params, plus the event topics. Pass names to describe only those.

methods.name: mechanica.info
methods.description: Game name, protocol version, tick rate, the current tick, this connection's scopes and caller, and the names of every action and query.

methods.name: mechanica.join
methods.description: Joins the world as a player of your own, marked as an AI. From then on this connection's actions act as that player (its inventory, reach and quests), and SetPlayerInput moves it. Returns its peer, profile id and shown name.

name.description: The agent's name. Its saved player (inventory, health, position) follows the name, so use the same one to come back.

methods.name: mechanica.leave
methods.description: Removes the player this connection joined as (it is saved) and goes back to acting as an external agent on the host.

methods.name: mechanica.record.start
methods.description: Starts recording every state-changing Action API call on the host.

methods.name: mechanica.record.stop
methods.description: Stops recording and returns the recording.

methods.name: mechanica.replay.start
methods.description: Replays a recording through the validator as this connection, with the recorded tick spacing unless timed is false. Returns the number of calls it will replay.

methods.name: mechanica.replay.status
methods.description: Progress of the current or last replay: running, dispatched, total and mismatches.

methods.name: mechanica.replay.stop
methods.description: Stops a replay in progress.

methods.name: mechanica.subscribe
methods.description: Starts pushing mechanica.event notifications for the given topics (see mechanica.describe's topics). Returns the topics now subscribed.

methods.name: mechanica.unsubscribe
methods.description: Stops the given topics, or every topic when none are given. Returns the topics still subscribed.

methods.name: mods.conflicts
methods.description: Conflicts between the enabled mods: incompatible (not loaded) and override_clash (two mods override one part; the later wins).

methods.name: mods.create
methods.description: Creates a new mod folder with mod.json and empty parts/ and scripts/. It depends on vanilla unless dependencies says otherwise.

mod.description: New mod id, lowercase snake_case; also its folder name.

name.description: Display name; defaults to the id.

dependencies.description: Mod ids it needs; defaults to vanilla.

methods.name: mods.delete
methods.description: Deletes a file of a mod, and folders it leaves empty. mod.json can't be deleted.

path.description: Forward-slash path inside the mod, like parts/wheel.json.

methods.name: mods.enable
methods.description: Enables or disables a mod like the Mod Manager (enabling pulls in its dependencies, disabling its dependents) and saves the profile. Takes effect on mods.reload. Returns the mods that changed.

enabled.description: False disables it (and the mods that depend on it).

methods.name: mods.files
methods.description: Lists the files of a mod (or one folder of it): path, size and modified time.

folder.description: Folder inside the mod; null lists the whole mod.

methods.name: mods.import
methods.description: Imports an asset like the Part Editor: into meshes/, scripts/, textures/ or sounds/ under a clean snake_case name, reusing an identical file. A .gltf brings its buffers and images in companions. Returns the path to write in data.

file_name.description: The file's name, like Big Wheel.glb; it is cleaned to snake_case.

companions.description: A .gltf's buffers and images by relative path, base64.

methods.name: mods.list
methods.description: Installed mods in load order: id, name, version, enabled, can_disable, loaded, dependencies; plus profile entries that are not installed (missing) and folders whose mod.json is broken.

methods.name: mods.move
methods.description: Moves a mod in the load order (it stops at its dependencies and dependents) and saves the profile. Returns the index it ended up at.

index.description: Where in the load order it should go (0 is first); it stops at its dependencies.

methods.name: mods.read
methods.description: Reads a file of a mod: text for .json, .lua, .gltf, .md and .txt, base64 for the rest. Up to 2 MiB.

path.description: Forward-slash path inside the mod, like parts/wheel.json.

methods.name: mods.reload
methods.description: Reloads the enabled mods into the running world: parts, sounds, part scripts and bot types. World generation, recipes, raids, quests and characters change only in a new world (listed in next_world). Refused while clients are joined unless the host runs with --ai-allow-reload-with-clients, which drops clients whose mods no longer match (dropped_peers).

methods.name: mods.validate
methods.description: Loads all content as a world would (parts, sounds, world generation, recipes, bots, raids, quests, characters) and compiles every Lua script. Returns ok, error and warning counts, the mods that would load, the content fingerprint and every diagnostic (domain, severity, code, mod, file, json_path, line, message). A mod with part errors is left out, so its recipes and bots are checked once its parts load.

mod.description: Only this mod's problems (it is enabled for the check); null checks everything enabled.

methods.name: mods.write
methods.description: Writes a file of a mod (text or base64, up to 2 MiB), creating folders. Paths stay inside the mod; vanilla only changes under editor/. Returns the bytes written and a quick check: JSON syntax for .json, a compile for .lua. Run mods.validate for the full check.

base64.description: Content of a binary file (.glb, .bin, .png, .ogg, .wav), base64.

methods.name: package.export
methods.description: Validates an installed mod and exports it to <id>-<version>.zip in the packages folder. A mod with errors is not exported; ok is false and problems say why.

methods.name: package.inspect
methods.description: Checks a package in the packages folder without installing it: its manifest, every problem (unsafe paths, hashes, size limits, game version), and what installing it would do (new, upgrade, reinstall, downgrade, replace_broken; dependencies and conflicts).

params.description: Params naming a package file in the packages folder.

file.description: File name in the packages folder, like better_wheels-1.2.0.zip.

methods.name: package.install
methods.description: Installs a package from the packages folder into the mods folder after checking it. Replacing an installed copy needs replace: true. Takes effect with the next world.

file.description: File name in the packages folder.

replace.description: Must be true to replace an installed copy (upgrade, reinstall, downgrade or a broken folder).

methods.name: package.list
methods.description: Lists the mod packages (.zip) in the packages folder, by file name and size.

methods.name: package.uninstall
methods.description: Deletes an installed mod (not vanilla). dependents lists the installed mods that need it and stop loading. Takes effect with the next world.

methods.name: package.verify
methods.description: Compares an installed mod with the package.json it was installed with: files changed, missing or added since (MD1310).

methods.name: reports.bug
methods.description: Save a bug report with steps, expected and actual. The host adds the game's context, the calls since the world started as a replay, recent log lines and a screenshot.

area.description: The feature, tool, part or mod it is about.

screenshot.description: True (the default) to attach what the host's screen shows; a headless host notes why it has none.

replay_actions.description: Most state-changing calls to keep in the replay file, newest last; null keeps every call since the world started.

messages.description: Most recent log lines to keep (0 to 200).

author.description: Who is writing (a model or agent name); the connection's name when left out.

methods.name: reports.delete
methods.description: Delete a report and its files.

methods.name: reports.get
methods.description: Read one report, optionally with its replay recording and screenshot (base64 PNG).

replay.description: True to include a bug's replay slice.

screenshot.description: True to include the screenshot as base64 PNG.

methods.name: reports.list
methods.description: List saved reports, newest first, filtered by kind, session and tag.

session.description: Only this session (a folder name, or current); every session when left out.

limit.description: Most reports returned, newest first (1 to 500).

methods.name: reports.note
methods.description: Save a note: something noticed or worth remembering. Returns the saved report.

tags.description: Tags for filtering: lower case letters, digits, - and _.

screenshot.description: True to attach what the host's screen shows.

author.description: Who is writing (a model or agent name); the connection's name when left out.

methods.name: reports.recommend
methods.description: Save a recommendation: a change to the game or a mod, and why. Returns the saved report.

area.description: The feature, tool, part or mod it is about.

screenshot.description: True to attach what the host's screen shows.

author.description: Who is writing (a model or agent name); the connection's name when left out.

methods.name: reports.screenshot
methods.description: What the host's screen shows now, as base64 PNG with its width and height.

topics.actions: Every state-changing Action API call by players, bots and agents (not Lua scripts): peer, source, action, args, ok, code, message, value.
topics.bots: A bot spawned, was removed or attacked: kind, bot, plus the attack or bot view.
topics.chat: A chat line: the chat message.
topics.dialogue: A quest character spoke: quest, speaker, text, choices.
topics.drop: An item drop appeared, changed or was picked up: kind, drop.
topics.events_dropped: Sent automatically when a subscriber fell behind and notifications were dropped: count.
topics.fire: A fire went out: the fire view.
topics.hurt: A player took damage: peer, amount, cause.
topics.messages: Lua prints, warnings and errors from part, item and bot scripts, and host errors from agent calls: kind, source, script, creation, part, text.
topics.mods: Mod content was validated or reloaded.
topics.projectiles: A projectile was launched or landed.
topics.quest: Quest progress changed: the GetQuests state.
topics.raid: A raid started, advanced or ended: the GetRaid view.
topics.reports: An agent filed a note, recommendation or bug report.
topics.seats: Someone sat down or stood up: seat, seated.
topics.vitals: A player's vitals changed (health, death, respawn): the GetVitals view.

errors.-32600: not a JSON-RPC request, or an empty or oversized batch
errors.-32602: params don't fit the method (data.code bad_args)
errors.-32603: the host failed while handling the call (data.code internal_error)
errors.-32001: the host's validation refused it; message says why (data.code rejected)
errors.-32003: call mechanica.auth first, or the token was wrong
errors.-32004: can't be done now (nothing recording, no replay, busy)
errors.-32005: this connection lacks the method's scope (data.code forbidden)
